assets.title: 小屿 · 好奇的阅读搭子
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / original mascot character concept.
Create a beautifully drawn ORIGINAL anime chibi humanized mascot for a personal research, reading, learning and daily-planning desktop app. The user's desired reference category is the endearing Q-version anime humanoid companions seen in AI-product fan art: distinctive hairstyle and outfit, expressive personality, cute compact proportions. This is a fresh ORIGINAL design, not the DeepSeek whale girl: do not copy her blue hair, whale fins/tail, maid uniform, or brand marks.
Asset: one polished LANDSCAPE character concept sheet, about 1536x1024. Left half: ONE large full-body character in an appealing pose. Upper right: ONE large square app-avatar study of this SAME character, head and shoulders filling the tile with an easily recognizable face/hair silhouette. Lower right: THREE small expression heads of this same character (curious thinking, cheeky satisfied, sleepy) neatly spaced. Keep the character completely consistent across the sheet. No captions, letters, labels, logos, watermark, UI controls or decorative explanatory text.
Visual style: high-quality contemporary Japanese anime chibi illustration, 2.5-head proportions, polished fine colored line art with slightly thicker outer silhouette, luminous but controlled cel shading, expressive eyes with designed iris highlights, soft rounded cheeks, individual little quirks. A young-adult-coded scholarly companion rendered as a wholesome chibi. Tasteful and friendly, fully clothed, practical outfit, no sexualization, no pin-up poses, no chest emphasis. Draw crisp, professional character art, not western animal cartoons, not 3D clay, not photoreal, not an abstract logo. Calm near-white background and generous separation between studies. Character personality must be visible, not merely a generic smiling anime face with props. Keep outfit motifs few and memorable, suitable for later consistent expressions, icon and desktop companion animations.
Character direction A: bright, inquisitive, a little cheeky, the companion who leans forward when discovering an interesting idea.
Hair: a distinctive fluffy short seafoam-mint bob ending just below the jaw, two longer tapered side locks, one bent question-mark-like cowlick; a SINGLE coral-red bookmark-shaped hair clip tucked above the left temple. No animal ears or fins. Eyes: clear dark teal irises, a playful raised eyebrow and tiny asymmetrical smile.
Clothing: oversized ivory hooded jacket with deep teal collar and cuffs, coral zipper pull, a compact dark-teal knee-length pleated skirt, opaque dark tights and small ivory sneakers. One tiny page-shaped patch on the jacket pocket, no writing. The outfit is a cozy student-researcher's jacket, not a maid or sailor uniform.
Full-body pose: slight forward lean and confident little head tilt; one hand holds a small closed indigo pocket book against the hip, the other raises a single finger as if she just had an idea. Limbs and hands neat, pose natural.
App-avatar tile: rich muted teal backdrop, mint bob and coral bookmark clip clearly visible, big face, no book blocking the face.
Small expression studies: thoughtful tilted eyes touching cheek, proud tiny grin, droopy sleepy eyelids with the cowlick bending. Personality is smart, helpful, occasionally smug in an affectionate way.
Palette: seafoam mint, deep teal, ivory and one lively coral accent; vivid enough to have character, avoid beige overtones or generic blue-whale color scheme.

assets.title: 小澜 · 鲸鱼娘
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Design an appealing ORIGINAL anime Q-version humanoid mascot for a personal reading, studying and daily-planning app.
One LANDSCAPE character concept sheet, approximately 1536x1024, same layout across both directions: LEFT one large full-body character; UPPER RIGHT a large rounded-square app-avatar portrait of the SAME character; LOWER RIGHT three smaller expressions, curious/thinking, proudly happy, sleepy. Same hairstyle/outfit/accessories consistent in every view. No text, labels, writing, logos, watermark or UI.
Art direction: beautifully finished contemporary Japanese anime chibi illustration, a young-adult scholarly companion stylized with a very large expressive head and compact 2.5-head body, soft appealing face, luminous designed irises, clean fine colored linework with a clear outer contour, restrained cel shading, crisp polished edges, individual expression and posture. A product mascot with a recognizable identity, not generic anime fanservice. Fully clothed, practical cute outfit, wholesome nonsexual pose, no revealing clothes or chest emphasis. Near-white uncluttered sheet background. No realistic fur, no 3D rendering, no animal-only mascot, no folded-paper logo.
Keep avatar head and shoulders large so distinctive hair and expression remain clear at icon size. Give the character three or four large defining design choices rather than a pile of tiny accessories.
Character C, a gentle and playful ORIGINAL whale-girl research companion. Very pale silver-blue LONG hair with a clear medium-blue gradient at the ends, one broad rounded wave-shaped fringe and ONE short upright curled cowlick. Small blue whale-fin shaped ear features on the sides of the head, and a single friendly blue whale tail curved up beside the body; keep tail broad and compact, not enormous. Vivid ocean-blue eyes with a warm lively look, small amused smile, faint soft cheek blush.
Outfit: short navy-blue hooded CAPELET with a simple wide white trim over an ivory long-sleeved tunic and a knee-length navy skirt, opaque dark tights, soft blue ankle boots. A sky-blue oval clasp at the throat is the only jewelry. She wears practical explorer-academic clothing, NOT a maid outfit; no frilly headband or apron, no DeepSeek emblem or other brand marks.
Full-body pose: both feet together, body leaning slightly toward the viewer with a playful head tilt; holding a small closed white notebook with a plain blue cover corner in both hands against the chest. The tail gently curls to the side, visible in silhouette.
App-avatar background: clear medium ocean blue, silver-blue hair and blue eyes contrast well; include fin ears but keep the face dominant.
Expression heads: cheek-puff thinking, bright proudly satisfied little grin, sleepy half-closed eyes with droopy fins. Charming, a tiny bit mischievous, warm companionship. A polished original design in the broad whale-girl anime category, not a replica of an existing mascot.

Character D, a lively and clever ORIGINAL fox-eared humanized study companion. Thick short COPPER-ORANGE bob haircut with two distinctive large cream-tipped FOX EARS, one cream forelock and two rounded cheek-framing tufts; a single fluffy copper fox tail with a cream tip curled neatly at the side. Emerald green eyes with a lively raised eyebrow and slightly cheeky tiny smile. Still a human anime girl, not an animal face; small normal human nose and mouth, no muzzle.
Outfit: dark forest-green long-sleeved duffle jacket with two large cream toggle fasteners, an ivory high-neck shirt, a neat chestnut knee-length skirt, dark tights and soft cream lace-up ankle boots. A tiny plum bookmark tab at the jacket pocket is the only accent. No school uniform, no maid features, no collar bells, no revealing clothes.
Full-body pose: standing slightly three-quarter with a confident forward lean, one small hand resting on hip and the other lifting a plain cream index card beside the cheek as if sharing a clever discovery. Tail compact and silhouette readable.
App-avatar background: rich forest green, orange hair and cream ear tips pop clearly, face large.
Expression heads: head tilted with one finger at cheek thinking, eyes closed in a proud smug little grin, sleepy ears folding slightly. Personality warm and quick-witted, with a gently teasing clever streak, not a baby or aggressive fox.
Palette: copper-orange, cream, dark forest green, very small plum accent. Emphasize the ear silhouette and bright green eyes as the memorable identifiers.
